items.h3: Every Bit of Pipe Capacity Counts
items.body: A line half full of roots has much less room when storms push water back.
Clearing the line in late winter gets ahead of root growth and storm season.
We test backflow valves and [overhead sewer systems](/skokie/overhead-sewer-systems) on the same visit.

blocks.h2: What a Maintenance Visit Can (and Can't) Fix
blocks.intro: A maintenance visit is built around prevention, not repair. Here's where the line falls:
head: Included in a Maintenance Visit
Needs a Different Service
rows: A camera inspection to check your line's current condition
An active sewage backup. Likely fix: [Emergency Plumbing](/skokie/emergency-plumbing)
Catching early root growth or wear before it becomes a bigger problem
A cracked or collapsed pipe. Likely fix: [Sewer Repair](/skokie/sewer-repair)
A light interior clean as part of the visit
A heavy clog that needs full clearing. Likely fix: [Sewer Rodding](/skokie/sewer-rodding) or [Hydro Jetting](/skokie/hydro-jetting)
An honest assessment of what your line needs next
A line at the end of its lifespan. Likely fix: [Trenchless Sewer Repair](/skokie/trenchless-sewer-repair)
blocks.note: If your line needs more than a checkup, we'll tell you exactly what and why. No surprise upsells.

blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance Questions From Skokie Homeowners

items.q: Is yearly rodding normal for a Skokie home?
items.preview: For clay lines with roots, yes.
items.answer: For clay lines with known root problems, yes. It's far cheaper than an emergency backup.

items.q: Should I maintain the line or replace it?
items.answer: If the camera shows the line is sound apart from roots, maintenance makes sense. If it's cracked or sagging, a repair or liner can end the yearly visits.

items.preview: It helps, but protection does more.
items.answer: A clean line drains better, but when the sewer system is full, only a backflow valve or [overhead sewer](/skokie/overhead-sewer-systems) keeps water out.

items.q: Does the No Drip Club cover sewer maintenance?
items.preview: The club includes regular maintenance visits.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits. Ask how it applies to your line.

items.q: Should I add a cleanout outside?
items.preview: If you don't have one, it helps.
items.answer: If you don't have an outside cleanout, adding one makes service faster.

items.q: How much does sewer maintenance cost in Skokie?
items.preview: It depends on the service. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether your line needs rodding, jetting or a camera check. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
